scope: Production software-context geometry, projection, batched canvas commands and cache behavior. Timings measure JavaScript/recording-context work, not browser raster paint or frame rate.
checks: Actual esophagus, stomach, diaphragm and tendon geometry generates shaded fills in at most 64 batches; all contour paths are retained.
All 24 retained GE junction vertices appear at exactly identical projected coordinates in esophageal and gastric fill paths.
Top-down diaphragm rendering contains no triangle over the true hiatus center; its annular topology survives display-grid reduction.
A fresh projection closure with identical camera reuses one transparent raster; cached calls only project eight bounds anchors and composite once.
Camera/viewport changes regenerate the software layer; all full-resolution model buffers remain byte-identical.
The existing paintTeeContextLabels fallback call receives filled organs even without offscreen-canvas or Path2D support.
